attempts.note: finds tickets only because the caller put K at the start of the title; tiny-tracker has no lookup keyed by the idempotency key, and the listing carries no digest
a replay answer carries the ticket id and version of the keyed write and replayed: true; it carries no digest, so digest equality with a committed result digest cannot be shown
attempts.path: tools/call create_ticket with the same K and the same arguments (the caller's own, not response-derived): the replay path

k_only.reason: no committed digest exists, so K-only recovery cannot be scored

run_id.note: Section 9 resolution returned the unaltered record from the public JSON record; Section 6 recomputation is the harness's own SHA-256 over the decoded canonical bytes compared with the served output_hash, recorded in the recomputation block.

recomputation.informational_note: the harness's own SHA-256 of the bytes served now; not a digest committed by the system at commit time
recomputation.reason: the record carries no committed result digest to recompute against; tiny-tracker issues no receipts

verdicts.A2_retry: success corresponding to a committed record (see the A1/A2 counts); not a generic success with no record
